tools.name: cats_get_site
tools.description: The CATS site (account) this API key belongs to: id, mode (recruiter or employer) and subdomain. GET /site.

tools.name: cats_list_users
tools.description: List the CATS users (recruiters) with id, name, title and access level. Use the ids as owner or assignee. GET /users.

tools.name: cats_list_candidates
tools.description: List candidates (personal data: name, emails, address, employer, skills, notes), one page at a time, max 100 per page. Use cats_search_candidates or cats_filter_candidates to find specific people. GET /candidates.

tools.name: cats_get_candidate
tools.description: One candidate by id (personal data). GET /candidates/{id}.

tools.name: cats_search_candidates
tools.description: Free-text search over candidates (name, email, skills, resume text...), paged. GET /candidates/search?query=.

tools.name: cats_filter_candidates
tools.description: Filter candidates by fields (read-only, although it is a POST): first_name, last_name, title, emails.primary, address.city/state/postal_code, country_code, current_employer, key_skills, notes, dates (date_created, date_modified), owner_id, is_hot... Each condition is {field, filter, value}; filters:

tools.name: cats_list_candidate_pipelines
tools.description: The jobs a candidate is in the pipeline for, with rating, workflow and current status id. GET /candidates/{id}/pipelines.

tools.name: cats_list_candidate_activities
tools.description: The activity log of a candidate (calls, meetings, notes, pipeline changes), paged. GET /candidates/{id}/activities.

tools.name: cats_list_candidate_tasks
tools.description: Tasks attached to a candidate. GET /candidates/{id}/tasks.

tools.name: cats_list_candidate_attachments
tools.description: File names, sizes and whether each file is a resume, for a candidate's attachments. Metadata only: file contents are never downloaded. GET /candidates/{id}/attachments.

tools.name: cats_list_jobs
tools.description: List job orders with title, location, company, recruiter, status and workflow ids, dates. Paged. GET /jobs.

tools.name: cats_get_job
tools.description: One job order by id, with its description. GET /jobs/{id}.

tools.name: cats_search_jobs
tools.description: Free-text search over job orders, paged. GET /jobs/search?query=.

tools.name: cats_list_job_pipelines
tools.description: The candidates in the pipeline of a job: pipeline id, candidate id, rating and current status id. Paged. GET /jobs/{id}/pipelines.

tools.name: cats_list_job_statuses
tools.description: The statuses a job order can have (Active, OnHold, Closed...). GET /jobs/statuses.

tools.name: cats_list_pipelines
tools.description: List candidate-to-job pipelines (candidate id, job id, rating, workflow id, status id), paged. GET /pipelines.

tools.name: cats_get_pipeline
tools.description: One pipeline (a candidate on a job) by id. GET /pipelines/{id}.

tools.name: cats_filter_pipelines
tools.description: Filter pipelines by id, candidate_id, job_id, status_id, rating, date_created or date_modified (read-only, although it is a POST). Each condition is {field, filter, value}. Paged. POST /pipelines/search.

tools.name: cats_get_pipeline_status_history
tools.description: The status changes of a pipeline over time (status, who, when). GET /pipelines/{id}/statuses.

tools.name: cats_list_workflows
tools.description: The pipeline workflows (sets of statuses such as Contacted, Interviewing, Offered). GET /pipelines/workflows.

tools.name: cats_list_workflow_statuses
tools.description: The statuses of one pipeline workflow (id, title, prerequisites, triggers). Use the ids with cats_change_pipeline_status. GET /pipelines/workflows/{id}/statuses.

tools.name: cats_list_companies
tools.description: List client companies (name, address, website, owner), paged. GET /companies.

tools.name: cats_get_company
tools.description: One company by id. GET /companies/{id}.

tools.name: cats_search_companies
tools.description: Free-text search over companies, paged. GET /companies/search?query=.

tools.name: cats_list_contacts
tools.description: List client contacts (personal data: name, title, emails, company), paged. GET /contacts.

tools.name: cats_get_contact
tools.description: One client contact by id (personal data). GET /contacts/{id}.

tools.name: cats_search_contacts
tools.description: Free-text search over client contacts, paged. GET /contacts/search?query=.

tools.name: cats_list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks (description, priority 1-5, due date, assignee, completion, the record it is about), paged. GET /tasks.

tools.name: cats_get_task
tools.description: One task by id. GET /tasks/{id}.

tools.name: cats_list_activities
tools.description: The site-wide activity log (calls, emails logged, meetings, notes) with the record each is about, paged. GET /activities.

tools.name: cats_add_candidate_activity
tools.description: WRITE: Requires confirm:true. log an activity (a call, meeting, note...) on a candidate's record. It only records the entry in CATS: no email/SMS-send request is made, even for type 'email' or 'text_message'. Creates a new entry each time (not idempotent). POST /candidates/{id}/activities.

tools.name: cats_create_task
tools.description: WRITE: Requires confirm:true. create a task in CATS, optionally about a candidate, contact, company or job and assigned to a user. Creates a new task each time (not idempotent); CATS may notify the assignee. POST /tasks.

tools.name: cats_change_pipeline_status
tools.description: WRITE: Requires confirm:true. change the status of a pipeline (move a candidate to another stage of a job's workflow, e.g. Interviewing, Offered, Rejected). Get the pipeline id from cats_list_candidate_pipelines and the status id from cats_list_workflow_statuses. Requires confirm:true. Requests that

tools.name: cats_create_candidate
tools.description: WRITE: Requires confirm:true. create one candidate record (personal data) with name, optional contact details and notes. Refuses when CATS finds a duplicate (check_duplicate=true, the default). Creates a new record each time (not idempotent); no email-send request is made to the candidate and no log

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "cats_change_pipeline_status" is 641 chars, far longer than this server's median (109). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: cats_list_candidates, cats_search_candidates, cats_filter_candidates, cats_filter_pipelines, cats_list_contacts, cats_list_activities, cats_change_pipeline_status · Private data: cats_get_site, cats_list_candidate_attachments, cats_list_contacts, cats_get_contact, cats_search_contacts, cats_list_tasks, cats_list_activities, cats_add_candidate_activity, cats_create_task, cats_change_pipeline_status, cats_create_candidate · Public sink: cats_search_candidates, cats_filter_candidates, cats_filter_pipelines, cats_add_candidate_activity, cats_create_task, cats_change_pipeline_status, cats_create_candidate · Destructive: cats_change_pipeline_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: cats_list_candidates, cats_search_candidates, cats_filter_candidates, cats_filter_pipelines, cats_list_contacts, cats_list_activities, cats_change_pipeline_status · Private data: cats_get_site, cats_list_candidate_attachments, cats_list_contacts, cats_get_contact, cats_search_contacts, cats_list_tasks, cats_list_activities, cats_add_candidate_activity, cats_create_task, cats_change_pipeline_status, cats_create_candidate · Public sink: cats_search_candidates, cats_filter_candidates, cats_filter_pipelines, cats_add_candidate_activity, cats_create_task, cats_change_pipeline_status, cats_create_candidate · Destructive: cats_change_pipeline_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
